project_title: Biker 85 Girls & Customizable Moto Club Platform

persona_and_theme.archetype: Tactical Metal & Asphalt with Custom Accent Neon
persona_and_theme.emotional_tone: High-octane, empowering, rebellious yet organized, asphalt & chrome aesthetic with vivid pink/accent energy
persona_and_theme.customization_architecture: Theme styling fully driven by runtime CSS custom properties (--primary-hue, --accent-hue, --primary, --accent, --club-name, --logo-url) stored in club settings and injected at :root level for easy white-label branding.

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black uppercase tracking-wider leading-none
hierarchy.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wide
hierarchy.subtitle: text-lg text-slate-400 font-medium leading-relaxed

color_system.guidelines: Never use pure #000000. Use rich asphalt charcoal (#0B0C10) tint with metallic borders and glowing neon accents. Text must maintain minimum 4.5:1 contrast against dark surfaces.

motoclub_effects: Metallic exhaust pipe glow lines on hover
Speedometer-style percentage meters for dues and event attendances
Leather grain/asphalt texture overlays with subtle SVG noise
Tire tread pattern borders for card dividers
visual_enhancers.surface_styles: Glassmorphism with heavy backdrop blur (backdrop-blur-md bg-zinc-950/80 border border-white/10 shadow-2xl)

public_landing.header: Sticky translucent navbar with club logo, nav links (Sobre, Encontros & Eventos, Galeria, Contato), and 'Área do Membro' CTA button
public_landing.hero: Bold hero section with Biker 85 Girls custom chopper artwork, animated heading, quick stats (Membros Ativas, Quilômetros Rodados, Eventos do Ano), and 'Junte-se ao Moto Club' action
public_landing.events_preview: Grid showing upcoming public rallies with location, date badge, and 'Exclusivo para Membros' teaser tags
public_landing.gallery: Bento-style visual gallery of motorcycle trips, rallies, and club patches
public_landing.footer: Dark high-contrast footer with club logo, social links, terms, and admin portal access

member_area.header: Member navigation bar with active member badge, profile shortcut, dues status indicator
member_area.dashboard_grid: Personal summary cards: Next Event RSVP, Monthly Dues Status (R$ 30,00/mês), Member ID Card (Digital Badge with QR code mock), Recent Encontros Feed
member_area.events_list: Detailed events schedule with GPS map link placeholder, route info, roll-call list, and RSVP toggle ('Vou / Não Vou')

admin_dashboard.navigation: Sidebar or Topbar tabs: Visão Geral (Stats), Controle de Mensalidades (Grid de Pagamentos Jan-Dez), Gestão de Membros, Gestão de Eventos, Personalização do Club
admin_dashboard.dues_matrix: Interactive monthly dues table showing members vs 12 months, color-coded badges (Pago em verde, Pendente em vermelho), manual toggle switch for admin to mark payment
admin_dashboard.customization_page: Live preview club editor allowing admins to update Club Name, Logo URL, Primary Accent Color picker, Hero Title, and Monthly Fee (default R$ 30,00)

component_guidelines.shadcn_primitives: Customized Radix / Shadcn components (Dialog, Tabs, Select, Switch, Table, Badge, DropdownMenu, Toast via Sonner)
component_guidelines.forms_and_inputs: Styled dark inputs with explicit focus rings, neon hover outlines, and data-testid attributes on all buttons/inputs
component_guidelines.animations: Framer Motion staggered entrance for grid items, smooth modal transitions, tab switches

testing_requirements.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements, buttons, form inputs, status indicators, and tabs MUST include role-based data-testid (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='dues-table-member-row', data-testid='admin-mark-paid-button')
testing_requirements.language: Portuguese (pt-BR) text content throughout all pages
